transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what’s been troubling you or what brings you in today?

Well... I suppose I'm here because... I've been having some trouble lately. It's a bit hard to talk about, especially at my age. 

Um... sometimes, if I eat too much, I... I go to the bathroom and make myself sick. Throw up, I mean. I just... I really don't want to gain weight. I kept telling myself it was just a one-time mistake, but... well, it's not anymore. It keeps happening. I guess that finally scared me enough to make an appointment.
Besides making yourself vomit, have you been using other ways to control your weight, like exercising a lot more than usual or using laxatives or diet pills?
No... no, I haven't done any of that. Just... just what I told you.
Do you find yourself eating a lot more than most people would in a short period of time, like feeling out of control while eating?

I... yes. Sometimes. 

Um... usually if I'm by myself. Like if I get back from a late shift at the store, or... maybe after a bridge night. I just... I might start with some leftover casserole, and then... I'll have the cookies I baked, some crackers, maybe ice cream. Just... all in one sitting. 

I wouldn't ever put that much on a plate in front of anyone else. It's... well, it's hard to stop once I start.
How often do you make yourself sick after eating, and does this happen regularly, like at least once a week for several weeks?

Well... I suppose... yes. It's been happening most weeks. 

For the past several months, really. Usually after one of those... spells, when I eat too much. I go and make myself sick. I can't really pretend it's just an occasional thing anymore.
When you make yourself sick after eating, is it mainly because you feel extremely worried or upset about gaining weight or about the way your body looks?

Yes... I suppose it is. 

I just... I can't stand the thought of getting heavy. If I'm getting dressed for church and my skirt feels even a little tight, or... or if I catch a glimpse of my side view in one of the mirrors at the store... it just ruins the whole day. 

I just feel like... like everyone is looking at me and thinking I've completely let myself go. So... yes, that's why I do it.
